title: Inklusive 1972 / Inclusive 1974

description.main: An artist's book of 124 typographic poems by Christopher Williams, laid out as camera-ready advertising art for his radio adaptation of Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Inklusive. It was published for his exhibition Werbung: A 48 Hour Display of Quality Framing Materials at Maxwell Graham, New York.
description.extended:
Inklusive 1972 / Inclusive 1974 is an artist's book of 124 typographic poems by Christopher Williams, laid out as camera-ready advertising art for his adaptation of Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Inklusive.

The poems follow the format of 1970s film festival press packets, which supplied camera-ready art for advertising. Here they announce the availability of Inklusive in paperback, on broadcast radio and on long-play vinyl. The 36-page softcover was published for Werbung: A 48 Hour Display of Quality Framing Materials at Maxwell Graham, New York, a three-day presentation from 15 to 17 December 2023. That show marked the announcement that Williams's adaptation of Kroetz's 1971 play was available for broadcast on radio. The cover is set as the title page of a radio play, crediting Kroetz's stage play and the speakers Eva Mattes, Sebastian Bezzel, Norbert Stöß and Andreas Leupold.

Williams, born in Los Angeles in 1956, has spent recent years researching Kroetz's work for theatre, radio and television. The book joins his English translation of Inklusive (2020) and Theater in Review: Upper Austria (2024), both also published by Walther König. In 2024 the Neubauer Collegium in Chicago broadcast his recording of the play on Lumpen Radio during the exhibition Radio/Rauhfaser/Television.

notes: No ISBN found. The '1659580' that Zwirner and Capitain Petzel list as ISBN is a 7-digit stock code. Year conflict: Zwirner shop page and Capitain Petzel say 2024; Zwirner's news item says 2023, and the launch exhibition was December 2023. Recorded 2024 per the product listings. The cover image (shared by Zwirner and Capitain Petzel) reads '3. Auflage' at bottom right, which may be part of the design or mark a third printing.
